title: Normas Técnicas para la Gestión de Riesgos Ambientales y Sociales (NRP-53)
citation: NRP-53, CNBCR-01/2024, Comité de Normas del Banco Central de Reserva de El Salvador
evidence: Header of every page of the BCR PDF: "CNBCR-01/2024 NRP-53 Aprobación: 31/01/2024 ... Vigencia: 15/02/2024". Opened https://www.bcr.gob.sv/regulaciones/upload/NRP-53.pdf on 2026-11-03 (listed on https://www.bcr.gob.sv/regulaciones/normas.php, reference NRP-53, Mercados: Captadores de Depósitos).
notes: Link only: row SV-BCR-ADOPTED is permission requested (BCR Carta de derecho: no commercial reproduction without authorisation, no alteration; Art. 50 of the Ley de Propiedad Intelectual considered and not applied, see the row). The PDF is a text PDF (pdftotext readable, 16 pages). Mapped to F1: it is a bank risk-management norm that also requires disclosure of environmental and social risk, so F1 fits better than the F6 the earlier register row carried. It is a state regulation issued under Art. 99 of the Ley de Supervisión y Regulación del Sistema Financiero, binding on deposit takers. The register row title is kept and its official_source_url now points at the NRP-53 PDF instead of the regulations search page. No government English translation was found (looked for on bcr.gob.sv/regulaciones and ssf.gob.sv). The Taxonomía Verde de El Salvador (SSF, BCR, MARN, IFC; launched 2025-12-02) is a voluntary national reference framework, not an enacted instrument, and is not in scope.

title: Ley del Medio Ambiente (Decreto Legislativo 233 de 1998)
citation: Decreto Legislativo 233 of 2 March 1998, Diario Oficial 79, tomo 339, 4 May 1998
evidence: Art. 116: "La presente ley entrará en vigencia ocho días después de su publicación en el Diario Oficial." Published in the issue of 1998-05-04 (page header "DIARIO OFICIAL - SAN SALVADOR, 4 DE MAYO DE 1998", tomo 339), so eight days after is 1998-05-12 (computed). Read on 2026-11-03 from the scanned issue PDF https://www.diariooficial.gob.sv/seleccion/24985, printed page 25.
notes: Stored from the Diario Oficial issue of 1998-05-04 (tomo 339) under row SV-DIARIOOFICIAL-ADOPTED (pass on statute, Art. 50 of the Ley de Propiedad Intelectual, ruling 2026-11-03). The text is uncorrected OCR output of a scanned official PDF (tesseract 5.3.4, language pack spa, 300 dpi); the diagonal watermark "DIARIO OFICIAL SOLO PARA CONSULTA, NO TIENE VALIDEZ LEGAL" garbles the middle of many lines and those misreads are left as read. The whole-gazette PDF is cut to PDF pages 2 to 24 (the law, Decreto 233 to the signature page). The Asamblea consolidated text (amendments since 1998) could not be reached: asamblea.gob.sv is blocked from the cloud address (row SV-ASAMBLEA-CONSOLIDATED, left as it was). Environmental framework act; the Reglamento General is sv-lma-reglamento-general. Spanish only; no government English translation was found.

title: Reglamento General de la Ley del Medio Ambiente (Decreto Ejecutivo 17 de 2000)
citation: Decreto Ejecutivo 17 of 21 March 2000, Diario Oficial 73, tomo 347, 12 April 2000 (nueva publicación)
evidence: Art. 129: "El presente Decreto entrará en vigencia ocho días después de su publicación en el Diario Oficial." Signed "en Casa Presidencial: San Salvador, a los veintiún días del mes de marzo del año dos mil". The issue of 2000-04-12 lists it as "(Nueva publicación)", so an earlier first publication exists whose date no page read states. Read on 2026-11-03 from the scanned PDF https://www.diariooficial.gob.sv/seleccion/25452, printed pages 15 to 35.
notes: Stored from the Diario Oficial issue of 2000-04-12 (tomo 347) under row SV-DIARIOOFICIAL-ADOPTED (pass on statute, Art. 50 of the Ley de Propiedad Intelectual, ruling 2026-11-03). The text is uncorrected OCR output of a scanned official PDF (tesseract 5.3.4, language pack spa, 300 dpi); the diagonal watermark garbles the middle of many lines and those misreads are left as read. The whole-gazette PDF is cut to PDF pages 15 to 35 (the Decreto Ejecutivo 17 with its Apéndice No. 1 glossary). The header of this republication says the decree was published again because the issue Diario Oficial 63, tomo 346, of 29 March 2000 came out incomplete; in_force stays null because no page states an in-force date. Implements sv-lma-233. Spanish only; no government English translation was found.

title: Ley de Protección al Consumidor (Decreto Legislativo 776 de 2005)
citation: Decreto Legislativo 776 of 18 August 2005, Diario Oficial 166, tomo 368, 8 September 2005
evidence: Art. 172: "El presente Decreto entrará en vigencia treinta días después de su publicación en el Diario Oficial." Published in the issue "JUEVES 8 DE SEPTIEMBRE DE 2005 NUMERO 166", so thirty days after is 2005-10-08 (computed). Opened https://www.diariooficial.gob.sv/seleccion/26733 on 2026-11-03 (pdftotext readable, law on pages 5 to 34). Art. 31 prohibits "todas las formas de publicidad engañosa o falsa".
notes: Stored from the Diario Oficial issue of 2005-09-08 (tomo 368) under row SV-DIARIOOFICIAL-ADOPTED (pass on statute, Art. 50 of the Ley de Propiedad Intelectual, ruling 2026-11-03). The text is uncorrected OCR output of the official PDF (tesseract 5.3.4, language pack spa, 300 dpi, page images only); this issue also carries a text layer, which was ignored because the watermark letters are interleaved into it. The whole-gazette PDF is cut to PDF pages 5 to 34 (Decreto 776 to the signature page). Umbrella for misleading advertising, including environmental claims; it has no environmental-claims rule of its own. Adopted text only; later amendments were not reachable (asamblea.gob.sv blocked). Spanish only; no government English translation was found.
